housing.text: Perea's housing platform calls for building more homes so families can afford to live where they work, and she is endorsed by California YIMBY.
housing.quote: Build more housing so every family can afford to live where they work

safety.text: Perea sponsored a city ordinance allowing Fresno to penalize jurisdictions that transport members of their homeless populations to Fresno.
safety.quote: A city ordinance to allow Fresno to penalize jurisdictions for transporting members of their local homeless population to Fresno

sentencing.text: Perea sponsored a resolution urging the state to deny parole for a convicted serial rapist.
sentencing.quote: A resolution approved by all councilmembers urging the state to deny parole for a convicted serial rapist

gender.text: Perea, who identifies as part of the LGBTQ+ community, says she will prioritize advancing LGBTQ+ equality statewide.
gender.quote: I will prioritize protecting civil rights, safeguarding reproductive freedom, and advancing LGBTQ+ equality statewide to ensure every Californian is treated with dignity and has the opportunity to succeed.

tax.text: Polsgrove says he supports lower taxes and protecting taxpayers.
tax.quote: I stand for stronger border security, law enforcement, less debt and lower taxes.

safety.text: Polsgrove lists law enforcement among the things he stands for and emphasizes reducing crime.
